title.zh: 手机片段：音频主机写错，159 条全指向解析不了的域名
title.en: Phone clips: all 159 audio addresses named a host that does not resolve

highlights.zh: 自 v2.37.6 起片段清单的主机写成 r2mirror.wangda.today（DNS 解析不了），正确是 r2mirror.groove.wangda.today，所以手机壳一首也放不出，只是安静。159 条已重指。
highlights.en: Since v2.37.6 the clip manifest named r2mirror.wangda.today, which does not resolve; the mirror is r2mirror.groove.wangda.today, so the phone shell could not play a single clip — the only symptom was silence. All 159 are re-pointed.

highlights.zh: 发版门禁新增片段清单检查：上传前比对每条片段的主机与所配置镜像，不一致就拒绝发布。
highlights.en: The deploy gate now checks the clip manifest too: before anything is uploaded, every clip's host is compared against the configured mirror and a mismatch refuses the release.
